Danger.Title: Learning the Ropes
Danger.Description: Alright kid, I think we should start you off easy... I've tracked down a group of wild creatures deep beneath our surface. On your adventures underground, you may encounter formidable creatures known as Crawdads, Salamanders and Giant Shellys. Taking out a couple of them would make the world a lot safer.

Gilded.Title: Pay Day
Gilded.Description: Radiant beasts have been spotted prowling underground Terraria, illuminating a path of ruin. The Gilded Bat, Gilded Lycan and Gilded Slime light up their surroundings and pack quite a punch. It would be best if their numbers dwindled, even just a little...

Pinky.Title: Pinky, the World Ender
Pinky.Description: Never before have I heard of a creature with such terrifying power... It's pink, it's mean, and it journeys around with a powerful storm of slime. Destroy it!

Nymph.Title: Damsel of Distress
Nymph.Description: You've got a good heart, kid. Don't let that be the end of you with this contract... Deep within the caves, there hides a creature masquerading as a defenseless young girl. Once close enough, however, you'll see she's not so defenseless. Take her out if you find her!

Tim.Title: Casting a Shadow
Tim.Description: I've managed to track down quite an elusive dark caster in the deeper levels of our world by the name of... Tim. Names aside, he's got quite a bit of power behind him, but one fatal weakness. It seems he's quite prideful of his outfit. Maybe you should wear a gem robe to lure him out...?

Doctor.Title: Arc of the Lost Raider
Doctor.Description: Many adventurers have braved the intense foliage of the jungle, but few ever return. I sent a friend of mine, Doctor Bones, out on a mission to the jungle quite a while ago, but he hasn't returned... Could you go check out the jungle's surface at night and see if you can find any signs of him?

Minotaur.Title: Beast in the Maze
Minotaur.Description: The Dungeon is bad enough with skeletons and slimes roaming around, but with a Raging Minotaur loose, it gets even more complicated. That beast can charge at incredible speed, blindsiding anyone not paying attention and crippling their movement. Don't get staggered out there, kid.

Hag.Title: Haggard Hagglers
Hag.Description: Many try to take shortcuts in their quest for power, often calling upon the elements for their boon. There exists beings known as Hags that roam the world looking to steal back their traded youth. The Underworld, Jungle, Ocean and Sky are the most likely spots to find one. Do us a favor and take one out.

Bestiary.LifeCrystalMimic: The forces of Terraria have a sick sense of humor.
Bestiary.Tracker: The Tracker belongs to an order of warriors dedicated to finding and dispatching rare creatures. Help him and he'll help you.
Bestiary.RedHag: Haggard witches who traded their youth for mastery over the flame. Clearly the trade didn't work out for them given how they're trying to murder you.
Bestiary.GreenHag: Haggard witches who traded their youth for mastery over the earth. Clearly the trade didn't work out for them given how they're trying to murder you.
Bestiary.BlueHag: Haggard witches who traded their youth for mastery over the waves. Clearly the trade didn't work out for them given how they're trying to murder you.
Bestiary.CyanHag: Haggard witches who traded their youth for mastery over the winds. Clearly the trade didn't work out for them given how they're trying to murder you.
Bestiary.RagingMinotaur: Roaming the maze-like halls of the Dungeon, these bulls charge down them with enough force to stagger anyone unfortunate enough to get hit.
Bestiary.GelatinousCube: A gluttonous mass of slime formed from the dank aura of the Dungeon. Has lost its ability to hop from the weight of its sins.
Bestiary.GelatinousSludge: The torn offspring from a Gelatinous Cube. Retains its ability to hop by ignoring the sins of its father.
Bestiary.Shambler: Downtrodden prisoners in their past life, these shackled skeletons will gleefully force their burden onto their eventual vanquishers.
Bestiary.BigBone: This tough skeleton takes the term "big boned" to the next level.
Bestiary.Warg: A hulking wolf that only prowls when the moon runs red. Its matted hide turns aside most blades, and it has never once considered stopping.
Bestiary.Nestling: A species of avian that loves to cohabitate with Harpies, care for baby birds, and pelt curious Terrarians.
Bestiary.WindElemental: Loose magicks that drift high into the air will occasionally manifest into these agitated beings. They can give quite a nasty zap to unaware Terrarians.
Bestiary.SpaceSlime: Apparently slimes exist on other planets, too. Who knew?
Bestiary.SnowBall: These guys take the idea of snowball fights and roll with it a little too much!
Bestiary.Barracuda: This quick fish is known for hunting down its prey by any means. Not even walls will block their vicious appetite.
Bestiary.Blowfish: Don't blow off this blowhard, they'll blow your socks off when brought down!
Bestiary.GigaClam: Terrarians have long debated whether this clam's size should be classified as 'giga' or 'massive'. Giga has won for now.
Bestiary.Octopus: A bulbous water dweller that extends its long arms to grab and crush its prey, even through walls at times.
Bestiary.Viscount: Massive in both size and ego, the Viscount is the undisputed lord of the caverns.
Bestiary.BiteyBaby: Servants of the Viscount. Often sent out to scout for new sources of blood and occasionally snacks.
Bestiary.ArmyAnt: An aggressive ant that patrols the depths of the jungle in search of prey.
Bestiary.Blacksmith: A skilled craftsman who shapes metal into weapons and tools. His work is as reliable as his temper is steady.
Bestiary.DesertAcolyte: The Desert Acolyte is quite nervous, but sells all sorts of equipment for those interested in throwing things at monsters.
Bestiary.Cobbler: The Cobbler long ago retired from his heroic days, but continues to supply quality footwear for the next generation.
Bestiary.Diverman: The Diverman is a curious adventurer in search of the mysterious Aquatic Depths. He's willing to sell some submerged treasures.
Bestiary.ConfusedZombie: The Confused Zombie is a chemist who turned into a zombie. Although he's managed to retain most of his sanity, he's still a bit strange.
Bestiary.FireAnt: It emerged straight from hell, like a flaming ant seeking heat.
Bestiary.StrangeBulb: A bizarre plant species that has yet to reach maturity. Perhaps it's better that way.
Bestiary.MahoganyEnt: A sentient mass of mahogany that seeks to protect the jungle's flora by lethal means.
Bestiary.EarthenGolem: A huge construct of compacted stone and earth, animated by ancient forces. It remains dormant until disturbed, then reacts with crushing force.
Bestiary.EarthenBat: A rudimentary bat formed from stone that hides in cave ceilings. It dives at intruders with surprising speed despite its rigid body.
Bestiary.GildedBat: A large golden bat. Its metallic sheen reflects light to disorient prey before striking.
Bestiary.GildedLycan: A fearsome predator covered in natural golden armor. It stalks its prey patiently before delivering swift, brutal attacks.
Bestiary.GildedSlime: A viscous organism infused with golden particles. It absorbs impacts easily and slowly engulfs anything careless enough to get close.
Bestiary.GildedSlimeling: A smaller version of the Gilded Slime. Less resilient, but far more numerous and irritatingly persistent.
Bestiary.TheGrandThunderBird: Blessed with mastery over storms, this majestic bird soars the desert skies. It seemed to be testing you...
Bestiary.StormHatchling: An electrically charged apparition of a young Thunder Bird.
Bestiary.TheInnocent: This innocent creature roamed the forests of Terraria peacefully before the dark corruption reached it.
Bestiary.LivingHemorrage: A grotesque teratoma formed from the very flesh of the Crimson. It doesn't usually fall easily.
Bestiary.CoinBagGold: You'd think gold would make this greedy sack of coins heavier, but it only increases its determination to flee from Terrarians.
Bestiary.CoinBagCopper: This enchanted pile of coins gained consciousness only recently, but will do anything to keep its riches to itself.
Bestiary.FlamekinCaster: A bizarre creature uses the power of lava pools found deep in the caverns to summon explosive fire bats.
Bestiary.Biter: The zombification process can result in individualities. This one simply bleeds a lot.
Bestiary.Clot: As we said, it doesn't like to fall easily.
Bestiary.ManofWar: With an unmatched sting and a tendency to become inexplicably invulnerable, this is one tough jellyfish.
Bestiary.Sharptooth: Though the name is quite obvious, it took one bite of a Terrarian's hand for this fish to earn its title.
Bestiary.Hammerhead: This poor guy couldn't figure out how to stand out among his shark friends... until he decided to use his head.
Bestiary.GraveLimb: A necrotic, stubborn appendage that loves ripping faces off. Undoubtedly the worst facial massage you'll ever receive!
Bestiary.PatchWerk: A horrifying creature formed from the decomposing, maggot-infested remains of Terrarians. It cries out to whoever is listening, begging to be put down.
Bestiary.Abomination: The stitched-together remains of several zombies. The seams themselves have seen better days...
Bestiary.FamishedMaggot: A ferocious worm, known for its propensity to attack in swarms.
Bestiary.BloodDrop: The animated blood behaves remarkably similarly to Terraria's slimes.
Bestiary.SeveredLegs: These legs were made for walking, and that's exactly what they'll do... well, actually, that's all they can do.
Bestiary.ZealousJellyfish: A red jellyfish that loves charging at enemies for its Queen.
Bestiary.SpittingJellyfish: A yellow jellyfish that loves spitting bubbles at enemies for its Queen.
Bestiary.DistractingJellyfish: A blue jellyfish that loves taking hits for its Queen.
Bestiary.CoinBagSilver: After passing through the caverns, this coin bag leaves the area as soon as a greedy Terrarian appears.
Bestiary.CorpseBloom: It's unclear if this mutant flower earned its name from its foul odor, or what it typically leaves Terrarians as in its wake.
Bestiary.CorpseWeed: The living roots of a Corpse Bloom can be just as dangerous as its host plant. Perhaps even moreso!
Bestiary.Druid: A wandering herbalist who gathers seeds from every corner of the world, no matter how hostile.
Bestiary.Cook: A seasoned chef who can turn even the simplest ingredients into a meal fit for an adventurer.
Bestiary.AncientArcher: Precise units from an ancient civilization, they use powerful bronze bows to pick off opposition from a distance.
Bestiary.AncientCharger: Swift warriors of a forgotten civilization, they charge through marble caverns with relentless force.
Bestiary.AncientPhalanx: Colossal guardians from an ancient civilization, they have little to protect but themselves.
Bestiary.BizarreRockFormation: A stone figure in the shape of a Terrarian; you can't shake the feeling that its rocky eyes are following you...
Bestiary.GraniteEnergyStorm: The uncontrollable epicenter of the energy surge within the granite caverns. Stimulated by dispelling Skeletron's curse.
Bestiary.GraniteFusedSlime: A slime that absorbed so much granite energy it began to glow from within.
Bestiary.GraniteEradicator: A floating construct of living granite, built to purge anything that wanders too deep.
Bestiary.GraniteSurger: A hovering husk of charged granite that lobs bolts of raw energy from above.
Bestiary.UnstableEnergyAnomaly: A knot of granite energy that never settled. Break it and whatever is inside gets out.
Bestiary.QueenJellyfish: The matriarch of the reef, swollen with stolen light. Sailors who see her glow rarely make it back to shore.
Bestiary.BuriedChampion: A warrior sealed in marble long before Terraria's first dawn, still refusing to concede the duel.

NPCChat.Tracker_1: Seen any interesting beasts lurking around lately? Minotaurs? Beholders? Gorgons?
NPCChat.Tracker_2: Bear your scars with pride, as each one has a tale to tell... What do your scars say about you, hero?
NPCChat.Tracker_3: Many beasts have fallen to me and my axe, but new ones are always on the prowl. Keep your eyes peeled, kid.
NPCChat.Tracker_4: You would be surprised how effective a single shoulder pad can be.
NPCChat.Tracker_Stylist: Do you think {0} would give a haircut even to a brute like me...?
NPCChat.Tracker_Gym: {0} and I were gonna start a gym together. You want in?
NPCChat.Blacksmith_2: A good blade makes all the difference.
NPCChat.Blacksmith_3: I can hear the metal calling.
NPCChat.Blacksmith_4: Bring the materials, I'll make it worth your while.
NPCChat.DesertAcolyte_1: We have quite strange people in this town, don't you think...?
NPCChat.DesertAcolyte_2: You didn't see shadows of giant birds while in the desert, did you?
NPCChat.DesertAcolyte_3: I'd only stopped to fill my canteen, but you look like someone capable of handling a real threat!
NPCChat.DesertAcolyte_4: Have you heard of the Thunder Birds? Legend says they protected our world from catastrophic threats, until a conflict between them and three individuals led to their disappearance...
NPCChat.ConfusedZombie_1: I can't remember much of my past life... I think chemicals and such were my passion; I only get fragments of the truth. Sometimes it's kind of sad...
NPCChat.ConfusedZombie_2: Most people don't have the stomach to deal with the things I sell. The trick is to have no stomach at all!
NPCChat.ConfusedZombie_3: I need to thank you for letting me stay here. Going out only at night is quite boring...
NPCChat.ConfusedZombie_4: Why am I not like the others...? Oh, sorry, did you need something?
NPCChat.Cobbler_1: In my younger days, I too was a hero. But after a nasty fall, I retired. Perhaps if I'd had better boots back then, I'd still be out saving the world...
NPCChat.Cobbler_2: Don't worry, young adventurer. The journey may be difficult, but I have complete confidence in you!
NPCChat.Cobbler_3: Proper footwear is no joke, {0}. Always keep your shoes clean and ready for adventure!
NPCChat.Cobbler_4: You learn a lot by walking a mile in someone else's shoes. Too bad some of the locals here have never done that...
NPCChat.Cobbler_5: How are you, {0}? Have you been careful out there in the wild lands?
NPCChat.Cobbler_Guide: So it was {0} who's been giving you advice all this time? It's always good to see a young person valuing studies.
NPCChat.Cobbler_PartyGirl: Can you believe {0} wanted to throw me a birthday party? It's been so long since I've had one!
NPCChat.Cobbler_Wizard: Oh my... I think {0} might be even older than me!
NPCChat.Diverman_1: Have you ever ventured into the aquatic depths...? Its suffocating atmosphere keeps most explorers out, but I'm sure you'll find a way around that...
NPCChat.Diverman_2: I've collected many maritime items on my travels, hero. Would you like to buy one?
NPCChat.Diverman_3: Spending long periods at the bottom of the ocean taught me one thing: always be prepared!
NPCChat.Diverman_4: You'd think it would be hard to breathe with this helmet, but I've actually gotten used to it.
NPCChat.Diverman_5: Have you ever tried drinking a bottle of water while drowning to save yourself? I have!
NPCChat.Diverman_6: The ocean rewards the curious... and punishes the unprepared. The second part usually comes first.
NPCChat.Diverman_7: If you hear something swimming behind you, don't look back. Keep swimming. It works... sometimes.
NPCChat.Diverman_8: The best discoveries are always at the bottom of the sea. Coincidentally, the most dangerous monsters too.
NPCChat.Diverman_9: I've slept with the fishes once, it was the worst feeling.
NPCChat.Diverman_10: Never underestimate a small sea creature. It usually has much bigger friends nearby.
NPCChat.Diverman_11: If you plan to explore submerged caves, bring plenty of light. The darkness down there seems alive.
NPCChat.Diverman_12: Breathing underwater seems impossible... until you find the right equipment.
NPCChat.Druid_1: Getting these seeds is a bigger hassle than you would think. Nearly drowning, almost melting, freezing to- You get the idea.
NPCChat.Druid_2: I often take visits to the jungle. I can understand the aversion to the place, but the creatures within don't seem to hassle me...
NPCChat.Druid_3: My mother was a well known herbalist back in the day. She doesn't talk about my father, though. I wonder why?
NPCChat.Druid_4: How does today find you, {0}? Make sure to stop and smell the roses!
NPCChat.Druid_5: Even a small seed can grow into a mighty oak! Keep that in mind, {0}...
NPCChat.Druid_6: The natural world is quite a wonder. Every little place has its own charm. Some more than others!
NPCChat.Druid_BloodMoon_1: Why don't you go fetch those seeds yourself you lazy, good for nothing-
NPCChat.Druid_BloodMoon_2: I bet you don't even feel guilty about destroying the natural world to better suit your needs...
NPCChat.Druid_WitchDoctor: Our friend there, {0}, is rather strange isn't he? He speaks in riddles...
NPCChat.Druid_Dryad: Ever since I was a child, I've always wanted to meet a dryad. What luck it is to find {0} here!
NPCChat.Cook_Angler: {0} can be a real brat at times, but as long as he keeps providing me with fresh fish, I won't complain.
NPCChat.Cook_Dryad: Cooking for {0} is no easy task. She simply refuses to eat any form of meat!
NPCChat.Cook_WitchDoctor: The last time {0} asked me to cook for him, he requested bugs! This truly is a strange place...
NPCChat.Cook_1: I've got a lot of orders from the other townsfolk right now, make it quick!
NPCChat.Cook_2: How did any of you survive before I arrived? What could you have possibly been eating, dirt?
NPCChat.Cook_3: I'm stuck with dull knives while you wield weapons of unimaginable power? Give me a break...
NPCChat.Cook_4: No one should go adventuring on an empty stomach. Eat well, hero!
NPCChat.Cook_5: Supply me with the proper ingredients, and I can make some truly powerful foods for you, hero!
NPCChat.Cook_Donated: Thanks! Bring me {0} more {1} and I can get cooking.
NPCChat.Cook_RecipeUnlocked: Perfect! Here, take some samples of {0}. I'll start selling it from now on.
NPCChat.Cook_NoIngredients: You don't have anything I can use. Bring me: {0}
NPCChat.Cook_NothingLeft: You've already brought me everything I know how to cook!

Tracker.Content: Kid, I can't complain about much, now can I?
Tracker.NoHome: With a proper home, we can get down to business and start hunting some real threats.
Tracker.FarFromHome: Hey there, Kid. You staying safe out here?
Tracker.LoveSpace: Loads of space for me to swing this axe without fearing bashing the wrong mook, it's great!
Tracker.DislikeCrowded: I'm starting to feel a bit claustrophobic...
Tracker.HateCrowded: It's hard enough to navigate a space with my size as it is, there's too many people here!
Tracker.LoveBiome: Ah feels like home with all this {0} around. My people like it cold up in the north.
Tracker.LikeBiome: Ah feels like home with all this {0} around. My people like it cold up in the north.
Tracker.DislikeBiome: It's a pain to track down monsters when you start in such a safe place like the {0}.
Tracker.HateBiome: I would say 'let's get down to business', but the {0} is a bit TOO dangerous here...
Tracker.LoveNPC: If there's anyone in town that can give me a run for my money in an arm wrestling competition, it's {0}. Love that guy!
Tracker.LikeNPC: If there's anyone I can count on around here to know their stuff it's {0}.
Tracker.DislikeNPC: {0} just goes on and on about getting his robes dirty instead of getting the job done. Not a fan of that.
Tracker.HateNPC: {0} just doesn't understand the importance of standing and fighting. It sickens me.

Blacksmith.Content: Strange... the forge didn't sing even once today.
Blacksmith.DislikeCrowded: Too many people, too much noise... ruins the work.
Blacksmith.DislikeNPC: I prefer to keep my distance from {0}.
Blacksmith.HateBiome: {0} suffocates the flame. Can't work like that.
Blacksmith.HateCrowded: This chaos? No forge breathes in a place like this.
Blacksmith.HateNPC: {0} wears out my patience more than raw steel.
Blacksmith.LikeBiome: {0}... isn't bad. The forge holds steady here.
Blacksmith.LikeNPC: {0} understands the value of good work.
Blacksmith.LoveBiome: Now that's it—{0}. This is where a forge should be.
Blacksmith.LoveSpace: Plenty of space, stable air... that's how a forge breathes.
Blacksmith.NoHome: A forge needs a decent place. This won't do.
Blacksmith.FarFromHome: Being away from my tools doesn't feel right.
Blacksmith.SpecialMoodText: I don't work steel under moonlight. Nothing good comes of it.

DesertAcolyte.Content: The desert speaks in silence... you just have to listen.
DesertAcolyte.DislikeBiome: {0} seems... unnatural. The sands reject it.
DesertAcolyte.DislikeCrowded: Too many voices drown out the whispers of this place.
DesertAcolyte.DislikeNPC: {0} disturbs the balance I try to maintain.
DesertAcolyte.HateBiome: {0} suffocates the spirit of the desert. I can't stay here.
DesertAcolyte.HateCrowded: This noise... I can't hear the sands.
DesertAcolyte.HateNPC: {0} only brings disturbance. I don't want to get involved.
DesertAcolyte.LikeNPC: {0} follows a path not so different from mine.
DesertAcolyte.LoveBiome: Yes... {0} resonates with the true voice of the desert.
DesertAcolyte.LoveNPC: {0} understands more than they appear to.
DesertAcolyte.LoveSpace: The open air... the wind brings clarity here.
DesertAcolyte.NoHome: I need a place where the winds can pass freely.
DesertAcolyte.FarFromHome: Too far... I no longer feel the presence of the desert.
DesertAcolyte.SpecialMoodText: The winds are restless today... something moves beneath the sands.

ConfusedZombie.Content: I'm fine and full of life, thanks.
ConfusedZombie.DislikeBiome: {0} just... doesn't feel right. My joints hurt here.
ConfusedZombie.DislikeCrowded: My neighbors are a bit rude to me just because of what I am, it's so sad...
ConfusedZombie.DislikeNPC: {0} keeps giving me really weird looks.
ConfusedZombie.HateBiome: Do I like it here... Do I fear for my life... Do I li- Nope. Nope. I'm out.
ConfusedZombie.HateCrowded: So many people here! A full banquet... O-oh, you didn't hear that, did you?
ConfusedZombie.HateNPC: I bet {0} has a big, juicy brain... Not that I want... uh... do you need something?
ConfusedZombie.LikeBiome: {0}... at least it's bearable around here.
ConfusedZombie.LikeNPC: {0} always opens the doors for me, so thoughtful!
ConfusedZombie.LoveBiome: The forest just... makes me happy, as if I belong here.
ConfusedZombie.LoveNPC: I feel a strange but good connection with {0}. I don't know why, I just feel it.
ConfusedZombie.LoveSpace: I love an empty space, it leaves me in peace to make my repellents without worrying about others.
ConfusedZombie.NoHome: Ah, it seems I forgot where my house was. Can you help me with that?
ConfusedZombie.FarFromHome: Walk ten steps, look around, if I'm not home, then... what was that again...
ConfusedZombie.SpecialMoodText: Why am I not like the others? Oh, sorry, did you need something?

Cobbler.Content: I've still got plenty of energy, don't worry!
Cobbler.DislikeBiome: I'm too old to go walking around {0}.
Cobbler.DislikeCrowded: There are too many people around here, don't you think?
Cobbler.DislikeNPC: {0} could learn a thing or two about proper footwear.
Cobbler.HateBiome: If I were younger I'd even take on {0}, but now I'm too old for that!
Cobbler.HateCrowded: I can't keep up with so many shoe orders. It's too crowded around here.
Cobbler.HateNPC: {0} is just waiting for an accident to happen with those shoes.
Cobbler.LikeBiome: {0} isn't a bad place for a walk.
Cobbler.LikeNPC: {0} understands the importance of good footwear.
Cobbler.LoveBiome: The forest really is the best place for a walk.
Cobbler.LoveSpace: It's much easier to focus on work when I have some space. That really lifts my spirits!
Cobbler.NoHome: It's hard to work without a workshop. Think you can help me with that?
Cobbler.FarFromHome: I'll need to give my shoes a once-over when I get back home...
Cobbler.SpecialMoodText: My knees aren't what they used to be, but I can still recognize a good pair of adventurer boots.

Diverman.Content: The ocean depths hide wonders... and many ways to drown.
Diverman.DislikeBiome: I'm not fond of exploring {0}. I prefer where there's enough water to dive.
Diverman.DislikeCrowded: Too many people here. I can barely hear the sound of the waves.
Diverman.DislikeNPC: {0} looks like the type who'd jump into the sea without any preparation.
Diverman.HateBiome: {0} and I have never gotten along. There's nothing to explore there.
Diverman.HateCrowded: Crowds make me uneasy. The bottom of the sea is much calmer.
Diverman.HateNPC: {0} has clearly never faced the depths. You can tell from a distance.
Diverman.LikeBiome: {0} has some good spots for a dive.
Diverman.LikeNPC: {0} seems to understand that preparation makes all the difference in an adventure.
Diverman.LoveBiome: Nothing beats the ocean. The deeper, the better.
Diverman.LoveNPC: {0} would certainly be good company on an underwater expedition.
Diverman.LoveSpace: It's nice to have a little space. That way I can look after my equipment without interruptions.
Diverman.NoHome: I need a place to store my diving equipment. Can you provide one?
Diverman.FarFromHome: I'm starting to miss my base. Keeping equipment in order makes a difference.
Diverman.SpecialMoodText: The ocean always holds a new discovery for those with the courage to explore its depths.

Druid.Content: I'm as fresh as a daisy, thanks for asking!
Druid.DislikeBiome: I doubt much could bloom in such a nefarious place.
Druid.DislikeCrowded: Talking to your plants is good and all, but even they need some quiet time.
Druid.DislikeNPC: That darn {0} keeps setting fire to the grass with his explosives!
Druid.HateBiome: I doubt much could bloom in such a nefarious place.
Druid.HateCrowded: This place has got far too many people, I can't go a day without someone trampling on my herbs!
Druid.HateNPC: *cough* *cough* All that steam and smoke {0}'s gadgets produce is giving me a headache...
Druid.LikeBiome: This frozen tundra is no place to grow my flowers! ...Well I guess one of them could grow here, but that's besides the point!
Druid.LikeNPC: {0} is such a little sunflower. C'mon, you can't hate a girl who can make small woodland creatures flock to her whenever she sings!
Druid.LoveBiome: Well, it really shouldn't come as a surprise that I love the jungle, I practically grew up here!
Druid.LoveNPC: Ever since I was a child, I've always wanted to meet a Dryad. What luck it is to find {0} here!
Druid.LoveSpace: Feeling as great as a lone tree atop a hill!
Druid.FarFromHome: Oh hello! I was just gathering some herbs around this area. It's always fun to go far out from home and explore!
Druid.SpecialMoodText: Even a small seed can grow into a mighty oak. Give it time.

Cook.Content: The kitchen's warm, the pantry's full. What more could a cook ask for?
Cook.DislikeBiome: Nothing worth cooking grows in {0}. Just rocks and dirt.
Cook.DislikeCrowded: Too many cooks spoil the broth, and too many neighbors spoil my mood.
Cook.DislikeNPC: {0} keeps sneaking into my pantry when I'm not looking.
Cook.FarFromHome: I'm far from my kitchen and my ingredients are going to spoil!
Cook.HateBiome: You expect me to find fresh produce in {0}?
Cook.HateCrowded: I can barely turn around without bumping into someone! Get them out of my kitchen!
Cook.HateNPC: {0} once asked me to season food with motor oil. Never again.
Cook.LikeBiome: {0} has decent ingredients, I'll give it that.
Cook.LikeNPC: {0} brings me good ingredients now and then.
Cook.LoveBiome: All these mushrooms growing right outside my door! I could cook for days.
Cook.LoveNPC: {0} always appreciates a good meal. That's all I ask for!
Cook.LoveSpace: Plenty of elbow room for a proper kitchen. Now this is how you cook!
Cook.NoHome: I can't cook without a kitchen! Find me a place to work, would you?
Cook.SpecialMoodText: Bring me the right ingredients and I'll cook you something worth fighting for.

SinalizationChatMessage.CorpseBloomDefeat: The elusive Corpse Bloom withers away...
